label: context.reference
text:
Use the Notion Application through world_mcp_notion. Project EE policy must admit it, and the task needs its exact interface binding and this artifact binding. Installation and connection do not establish server liveness.

Use the server's catalogs for Notion pages, databases, blocks, search, comments, and workspace capabilities that the connected server actually declares. Current capabilities are declared in mcp.operation_catalog, mcp.tool_catalog, mcp.resource_catalog, mcp.resource_templates and mcp.prompt_catalog from world_mcp_notion.

Invoke a tool with artifact.send to world_mcp_notion, label mcp.operation.request, operation notion.call_tool, and arguments containing the exact catalog tool name and argument object. Use notion.read_resource, notion.get_prompt and notion.complete with catalog identifiers; use notion.status or notion.ping to check liveness or negotiated capabilities.

Wait for the returned MCP result, resource, OAuth, event or refusal artifact before reporting an effect. Credentials, OAuth verifiers, tokens and refresh state stay private to the interface; transfer only non-secret handles and status artifacts.
